clue.text: Writer from Kent about to plagiarize

indicators.note: about means the Kent letters go around the copying word

parts.note: Kent is in the South East of England, abbreviated SE
to crib is to copy someone else's work

explanation.surface: A Kentish author is about to steal someone else's words.
explanation.definitionFit: A scribe is a copyist or, loosely, any author: a person who writes.

clue.text: Winger spotted poster

parts.note: a bill is a printed notice, a poster

explanation.surface: A footballer on the wing noticed an advertisement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Winger' suggests a footballer, but it is a bird, a winged creature.
explanation.definitionFit: The sawbill is a type of duck, the merganser, so a bird or winged thing.

clue.text: Called expedition leader for compass

indicators.note: leader means the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Someone phoned the head of the expedition to ask for a compass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'compass' is a noun for scope or extent, not the navigational instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: Range and compass both mean scope or extent.

clue.text: Egghead tours a hospital in the Middle East

indicators.note: tours means the egghead word goes around the other letters

parts.note: an egghead is a clever person, a brain

explanation.surface: A clever academic visits a hospital during a trip to the Middle East.
explanation.definitionFit: Bahrain is an island kingdom in the Persian Gulf, a country situated in the Middle East.

clue.text: Covering for drill in wagon

indicators.note: in places the drill letters inside the wagon word

parts.note: PE, physical education, is school exercise or drill

explanation.surface: Someone stores a drill inside a cart under a cover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drill' suggests a tool, but here it is PE, the British school subject of physical exercise.
explanation.definitionFit: A carpet is a floor covering of woven fabric.

clue.text: Embodiment of a Virginia mariner

parts.note: VA is the abbreviation for the US state of Virginia

explanation.surface: Someone is the very image of a sailor from Virginia.
explanation.definitionFit: An avatar is the incarnation or embodiment of a deity or an idea.

clue.text: One records the steps of tsar touring vault

indicators.note: touring means the tsar's name goes around the vault

parts.note: Peter the Great was a Russian tsar
a dome is a vaulted roof

explanation.surface: A Russian ruler's walk around a cathedral vault is counted.
explanation.definitionFit: A pedometer is a device counting the steps a walker takes.

clue.text: A revolutionary runs Kentucky

explanation.surface: A rebel races through a southern US state.
explanation.definitionFit: Leon Trotsky was a leading figure of the Russian Revolution.

clue.text: Revitalization of control over motor race

indicators.note: over in a down clue places the control word above the rest

parts.note: a rein is a means of control
a nation is a people or race

explanation.surface: A regulator takes control of a car race to revive it.
explanation.definitionFit: Reincarnation is rebirth in a new body, figuratively a revival or renewal.

clue.text: Bird of endless ostentation

indicators.note: endless means the synonym loses its final letter

explanation.surface: A bird puts on an unending display of vanity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' cuts the last letter, K, from SWANK.
explanation.definitionFit: The swan is a large, long-necked water bird.

clue.text: Driving technique gets man and beast to Spain

parts.note: the eland is a large African antelope
E is the international vehicle code for Spain

explanation.surface: A motorist's trick involves taking a man and an animal off to Spain.
explanation.walkthrough: E for Spain comes from the country's car registration code (España).
explanation.definitionFit: Heel-and-toe is a motorsport method of braking and blipping the throttle with one foot while changing down.

clue.text: A mince pie is an art form

indicators.note: pie is printer's jargon for jumbled type, so these letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A mince pie claims to be a work of art.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pie' looks like part of the festive treat, but it signals an anagram of A MINCE.
explanation.definitionFit: Film, shown in the cinema, is often called the seventh art form.

clue.text: Narrow escape for ship after marine disaster

indicators.note: after places the ship letters behind the rest
a disaster leaves things in ruins, so the letters are wrecked into a new order

explanation.surface: A vessel only just avoided a calamity at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disaster' reads as part of the maritime story but is the anagram signal; 'after' sets the ship abbreviation at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A near miss is a close call, something that almost happened but did not.

clue.text: All meat in stew is nutritious

indicators.note: a stew mixes its ingredients together, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: Putting all the meat into a stew makes it nourishing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' looks like a link but is part of the fodder: ALL MEAT IN is rearranged by 'stew'.
explanation.definitionFit: Alimental means relating to food, nourishing or nutritive.

clue.text: A comedian broadcast in south-eastern Europe

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so these letters are spread about

explanation.surface: A comic is aired across the Balkans.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' suggests television but is the anagram signal for A COMEDIAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Macedonia (now North Macedonia) is a Balkan country, located in south-eastern Europe.

clue.text: Speak about time for holiday

indicators.note: about means the speaking word goes around the time letter

explanation.surface: Someone talks about how long their vacation lasted.
explanation.definitionFit: A stay is a period spent visiting somewhere, as on a holiday break.

clue.text: Faction is first-rate without the French

indicators.note: without means the French article is removed

explanation.surface: A political group calls itself elite but drops anything French.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' removes LE from SELECT, leaving SECT.
explanation.definitionFit: A sect is a breakaway group or faction within a larger body.

clue.text: Son with pluck exorcising a curse

indicators.note: exorcising means driving the a out of the pluck word

explanation.surface: A brave son drives out an evil spell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exorcising' removes the A from COURAGE, leaving COURGE.
explanation.definitionFit: A scourge is a cause of great suffering, an affliction or curse.

clue.text: Recluse finds it in an irksome task

indicators.note: in means it goes inside the other words

parts.note: a chore is a tedious job

explanation.surface: A hermit discovers it among his tiresome duties.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finds' is only a link; 'in' signals that the pronoun sits inside the other words.
explanation.definitionFit: An anchorite is a religious hermit who lives withdrawn from society.

clue.text: The daredevil is the one in the brick container

indicators.note: in places these words inside the container

parts.note: a hod is a trough for carrying bricks

explanation.surface: The reckless one is the person standing in the brick trough.
explanation.walkthrough: A hod is the open trough a British bricklayer's labourer carries on the shoulder.
explanation.definitionFit: A hothead is a rash, impetuous person, much like a daredevil.

clue.text: Nurse without pain in the final stages

indicators.note: without means outside, so the nurse word goes around the pain

parts.note: to ail is to cause pain

explanation.surface: A nurse cares for someone suffering no pain at the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking', but here it means outside.
explanation.definitionFit: The tail end is the last part of something, its final stages.

clue.text: Work on stand for doubledealer

indicators.note: on in a down clue places the work letter above the stand

parts.note: W is the symbol for work in physics
an easel is a stand for a painting

explanation.surface: Someone works at an easel while being deceitful.
explanation.definitionFit: A weasel is a sly, untrustworthy person, a doubledealer.

clue.text: Apprehension of Old Bill in court

indicators.note: in places the old bill inside the court letters

parts.note: a fee is a bill or charge

explanation.surface: A suspect fears the police while appearing in court.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old Bill' is British slang for the police, a red herring: the two words act separately here.
explanation.definitionFit: Cold feet is an idiom for nervousness or loss of nerve before an undertaking.

clue.text: Lofty is a composer

explanation.surface: A tall person is said to be a writer of music.
explanation.definitionFit: Thomas Tallis was a sixteenth-century English composer of church music.

clue.text: Many imitate student in a flap

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty, so many
L is a learner, a student

explanation.surface: Lots of people copy a student who is in a panic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flap' suggests a panic, but it is the folded part of a jacket.
explanation.definitionFit: A lapel is the folded flap on the front of a jacket.

clue.text: Miller smiles about Dutch accent

indicators.note: about means the smiles word goes around the Dutch letter

parts.note: tone is a manner of voice, an accent

explanation.surface: A miller grins at someone's Dutch way of speaking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Miller' looks like a person but means the thing that mills: a stone that grinds.
explanation.definitionFit: A grindstone is a revolving stone that grinds or sharpens, so it is something that mills.

clue.text: Look both ways

indicators.note: both ways means the word reads the same forwards and backwards

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Someone is told to glance left and right.
explanation.definitionFit: To peep is to take a quick look.

clue.text: Sanction some given a blessing

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A clergyman approves some people who have received a blessing.
explanation.definitionFit: To enable is to authorise or permit, which is to sanction.

clue.text: Total supervised at sea

parts.note: to total is to add up

explanation.surface: Someone counts up what was overseen while sailing.
explanation.definitionFit: At sea is an idiom for confused, which is what addled means.
